description.en: The USB Type-C plug interface: a shell 8.25 × 2.40 mm that stands 6.65 mm out of an overmold at most 12.85 × 7.0 mm, mating a Type-C receptacle either way up.
description.es: La interfaz de la clavija USB Tipo C: una carcasa de 8.25 × 2.40 mm que sobresale 6.65 mm de un sobremoldeo de 12.85 × 7.0 mm como máximo, y que acopla con un receptáculo Tipo C en cualquiera de sus dos posiciones.
description.fr: L'interface de la fiche USB Type-C : un blindage de 8,25 × 2,40 mm qui dépasse de 6,65 mm d'un surmoulage d'au plus 12,85 × 7,0 mm, et s'accouple à une embase Type-C dans les deux sens.
description.pt: A interface da ficha USB Tipo C: uma blindagem de 8,25 × 2,40 mm que sobressai 6,65 mm de um sobremoldado de no máximo 12,85 × 7,0 mm, e acopla num receptáculo Tipo C nos dois sentidos.

governing.designation: USB Type-C Cable and Connector Specification, Release 2.5

sources.title: USB Type-C Cable and Connector Specification, Release 2.5 (March 2026)
sources.supports: Figure 3-1 (receptacle interface): shell opening 8.34 +0.06/−0.02 wide, 2.56 ±0.04 high; shell length 6.20 REF (6.20 ±0.20 effective when mounted, note 7); tongue 6.690 +0.045/−0.055 wide, 4.45 ±0.10 long, 0.70 ±0.05 thick over the contacts; signal contact pitch 0.5; §3.2.3: 24 pins. Figures 3-3 and 3-12 (plug interface): shell 8.25 ±0.03 wide, 2.40 ±0.03 high, 6.65 ±0.10 from the overmold face to the tip; overmold 12.85 max wide, 7.0 max high. §2.1 and §2.3.2: the plug mates either way up. Figure 3-82 (informative): the overmold face stays at least 0.05 off the product surface when the plug is fully seated. Figure 3-81 (informative): ports at least 7.50 apart stacked, 13.35 side by side, centre to centre. Note 8: a 1.5 min lead-in if the receptacle shell is modified

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the overmold's front face, on the shell axis. +z runs along the shell to its tip at z = 6.65; +x runs along the shell's width; +y = z × x runs along its height. The overmold and cable lie at z < 0.

shell_length.note: from the overmold face to the tip

interfaces.note: Male: the shell goes into a Type-C receptacle. Symmetry 2: either way up. A mate seats the overmold face on the receptacle's front face, a convention (the specification keeps the overmold at least 0.05 off the product surface). The x_axis is −x so that a mate (a half-turn about the frame's x, ASM-1 §3.4) puts the plug's +y side on the receptacle's +y side.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (console-hyperobjects standard-parts lane, 2026-11-01); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: The overmold's length is not normative (the figures show it as a reference), so only the shell is in the envelope.

solids.note: the shell, overmold face to tip

envelope.note: The shell at its nominal width and height; the overmold has no cited length and is not modelled.
